title: Can I Send A Mass Email Campaign Using Brilliant Directories?
text:
Can I Send A Mass Email Campaign Using Brilliant Directories?
The built-in email system is designed for emailing active members who have requested to receive emails from the site. A common example would be sending a monthly newsletter to members who have opted in to receive updates.
The email system also sends transactional emails, such as new member signup notifications, credit card update notices, lead emails, and other system-generated messages related to member activity.
Sending mass unsolicited emails to Claim Listings or an imported contact list may be considered spam. This can violate email compliance laws, damage the sending reputation of your domain, and result in future emails being blocked or blacklisted.
In some cases, sending spam messages can also negatively impact other sites on the same server and may lead to account restrictions or termination with Brilliant Directories.

title: Emails » Email Accounts
text:
Emails » Email Accounts
Email accounts (mailboxes) at the website's own domain, such as
support@example.com
, are created and managed in
Settings > Domain Manager > Mailboxes
. The
Emails > Email Accounts
menu item opens that tab directly.
Before starting
Connect a custom domain to the website. A free
directoryup.com
address has no mailboxes of its own.
Confirm which provider receives the domain's email. Mailboxes on the website's hosting receive new mail only when the domain's MX records point to them.
Open the email accounts
In the admin, open
Emails
.
Click
Email Accounts
.
Domain Manager opens on the
Mailboxes
tab, which lists the mailboxes, their storage use, and where the domain's email is delivered.
Email Accounts in the Emails menu (1) opens Domain Manager on the Mailboxes tab (2).
Create and manage mailboxes
On the
Mailboxes
tab,
Add a mailbox
creates a new mailbox with its password and storage limit. Each mailbox in the list offers
Open webmail
,
Set up
for the settings to enter in Outlook, Apple Mail, or a phone, and
More
for changing the password or storage limit or deleting the mailbox. The full steps are in
Settings » Domain Manager » Mailboxes and Email Routing
.
Generic addresses such as
info@
are more often treated as spam by receiving mail systems. Addresses such as
support@
,
admin@
, or
contact@
are usually a better choice.
When the previous Email Accounts page appears
The previous
Manage Email Accounts
page still opens in two cases:
The website uses a free
directoryup.com
address. The page explains that a live domain name must be connected before email accounts can be set up, and offers
Connect Live Domain
. See
How to Connect a Domain to a Brilliant Directories Website
.
The administrator's role does not include access to the Domain Manager's
Mailboxes
tab.
On a free directoryup.com address, Email Accounts shows the previous page with Connect Live Domain (1).
Additional notes
Email replies do not have a separate reply-to address. Responses go to the address that sent the original message.
To read a mailbox in the browser, see
How To Access Webmail Through the Admin Area
.

title: Email Forwarders
text:
Email Forwarders
Email Forwarders Not Supported
IMPORTANT:
The Email Forwarders functionality has been removed from our implementation of cPanel as of June, 2024.
Due to the way this functionality works in cPanel, it caused several issues for users. Some of these issue included:
Not all emails being forwarded properly based on the domain settings of the email sender and the receiver of the forwarded email
Sendgrid blocking emails from being sent to accounts hosted in cPanel, preventing the Admins of sites from getting notification emails
The domain reputation and reputation of the server being harmed when SPAM emails are forwarded through this system
While email forwarders can no longer be added or modified, any existing email forwarders will remain in place.  If an email forwarder needs to be removed from a site, please submit a ticket to our Support Team for assistance.
Recommendations to Replace Email Forwarders
The recommended alternative for using email forwarders is to use an email app that can send and receive emails from multiple email accounts in one place:
Gmail
Paid
Google Workspace
email accounts can connect to 3rd party email accounts to send and receive emails.  For this, the MX record would need to be pointed to Google workspace, for more information:
How To Change Email MX Records
Thunderbird
This is a free desktop email application from Mozilla, the makers of the FireFox browser. Thunderbird offers an app for Windows, MacOS, and Linux operating systems.
Apple Mail
Apple includes a free email client that can connect to 3rd party email accounts for all of their devices and operating systems.
Microsoft
Windows Mail
and
Microsoft Outlook
- Microsoft includes the Windows Mail and Outlook for Windows applications for free on devices using Windows 10 or newer. Both of these applications can connect to 3rd party email accounts.
